children.title: [M1] Preserve font fidelity in native SVG/PDF and report missing glyphs
criteria: Embed/subset the chart TTF in PDF with Unicode mapping; provide embedded-font or glyph-outline SVG output.
Share measurement, glyph fallback, advances, baselines, multiline and rotated text behavior with raster rendering.
Expose actionable missing-glyph diagnostics and document outline versus selectable-text behavior.
Verify embedded/default/Latin/custom fonts with independent renderers and PDF text extraction.

children.title: [M1] Define general axis and data-label collision policies
criteria: Specify deterministic behavior for dense ticks and mark labels: preserve, skip or reposition with documented defaults.
Fit labels on small canvases and preserve explicit multiline and UTF-8 boundaries.
Cover line/bar/area/combo/scatter/bubble; retain the completed pie/legend policies.
Add regression cases for dense, negative, log and long-label inputs across raster/vector output.

children.title: [M1] Bring legacy PDF pie helpers onto shared layout and style contracts
criteria: Map legacy PieVectorOptions layout/overlap settings to shared pie layout without silently dropping options.
Preserve injected report fonts, colors/alpha, strokes, doughnut geometry and labels.
Document source compatibility and any unavoidable default changes.
Test direct draw_pie/draw_pie_slices and explicit-options draw_chart_vector against shared exports.

children.title: [M1] Add public input validation with strict and permissive diagnostics
criteria: Review a public validation design with diagnostic code, severity and affected series/point/option identity.
Cover invalid dimensions/options, mismatched series, nonfinite data, invalid log domains, UTF-8 and unavailable glyphs.
Strict mode rejects invalid input before export; permissive mode reports skipped/repaired values with documented missing-data semantics.
Retain current source behavior by default and test diagnostics and export failure propagation.

children.title: [M1] Enforce configurable rendering and output resource budgets
criteria: Specify limits for logical/supersampled pixels, point counts, label bytes/counts and encoded output.
Check limits before expensive allocations/work and across PNG/JPEG/SVG/PDF and fallback paths.
Return actionable structured diagnostics/errors without mutating input.
Exercise boundary and overflow cases, supersampling, long labels and large point sets; document embedded budgets.

children.title: [M1] Automate independent SVG/PDF rendering and extracted-text checks
criteria: Render representative native SVG and PDF with independent readers and compare to raster with justified tolerances.
Check fonts/text, rotated/multiline labels, colors/opacity, geometry, crowded layouts and all built-in chart families.
Extract PDF text; verify native output contains no unintended raster images.
Run the checks in CI and retain failure artifacts; distinguish image-object checks from visual fidelity evidence.

children.title: [M1] Verify FetchContent and Conan installation workflows
criteria: Document a pinned FetchContent example and test that subdirectory defaults do not build dependency tests/examples.
Add a Conan recipe with explicit PDF/Latin-font and static/shared configuration.
Build relocated clean consumers using CMake and pkg-config where supported, with compile definitions and link dependencies.
Verify installed/source packages include required license notices and usable examples.

children.title: [M1] Finish and submit the vcpkg port against an immutable release
criteria: Replace SHA512 0 with the verified checksum for a published immutable release source artifact.
Verify default/PDF/Latin-font feature combinations and static/shared consumers.
Submit the port or appropriate upstream update and record the submission URL.
Record upstream acceptance separately; a submission is not evidence of registry availability.

children.title: [M1] Verify platform CI and harden dependency and source checks
criteria: Run the exact candidate through Linux x86-64/ARM64, macOS, Windows, static/shared, PDF, Latin-font and minimal Make checks.
Add Latin-font coverage; review/pin Actions and downloaded tools to immutable revisions/checksums with reviewed update policy.
Add dependency review and suitable automated source/static security checks; record actionable findings.
Attach successful remote run URLs and configure required release checks; local successes do not close this gate.

children.title: [M1] Fuzz numeric, UTF-8, primitive and exporter boundaries
criteria: Add bounded fuzz harnesses for numeric chart input, UTF-8 handling, rendering primitives and export dispatch/boundaries.
Run sanitizer-backed corpus smoke checks in CI with reproducible seeds and documented local commands.
Include nonfinite/extreme values, malformed strings, tiny/large dimensions and supersampling/fallback combinations.
Turn confirmed crashes or contract violations into regressions and triage every unresolved finding.

children.title: [M1] Lock documentation dependencies and verify fresh API generation
criteria: Lock transitive documentation dependencies and document the reviewed update/regeneration workflow.
Generate MrDocs from current public headers on a clean environment and verify the API reference covers new exports and diagnostics.
Build documentation in strict mode without relying on previously generated API artifacts.
Verify API links, guides, gallery and release/upgrade/security documentation match current behavior.

children.title: [M1] Refresh benchmarks and remove stale product/comparison claims
criteria: Record repeated render/encode timings, distributions, peak memory, output sizes, machine/compiler/build/revision metadata.
Cover supported backends, raw/decimated data, and 1k/10k/100k/1M workloads where bounded and practical.
Profile the slow pie case before assigning a cause; replace the old unsupported causal explanation.
Update API/header/benchmark/comparison claims and date competitor checks with primary-source links; avoid unverified publication/performance claims.

children.title: [M1] Produce reproducible release artifacts and clean-source smoke checks
criteria: Generate source archives and checksums reproducibly from an explicit committed revision; exclude build/generated/private files.
Build and install from the produced archive in a clean workspace, including core/PDF/font features and consumers.
Include licenses/notices, changelog and upgrade guidance and test example outputs.
Use the tested artifact/revision for an RC; record checksums, archive smoke logs and immutable publication coordinates.

children.title: [M1] Verify release publication, documentation and final acceptance
criteria: Review all original M1 roadmap items and record evidence or an explicit maintainer scope decision for each.
Confirm public repository, exact tested tag/commit, attached release artifacts/checksums and deployed documentation/gallery.
Verify version/license/security/upgrade metadata and a fresh consumer install from the published artifacts.
Close M1 only after implementation AND release evidence are complete; record external submission/acceptance statuses honestly.

later.title: [M2] Common 2D workflow parity — deferred until M1 acceptance
later.body:
Outcome: one-call export of a polished 2x2 analytics figure to PNG/SVG/PDF without manual pixel placement.

Planned scope:
- Shared AxisOptions: bounds, reversal, visibility, custom ticks/formatters.
- Numeric continuous line/area x positions and shared scatter log/time axes, overlays and per-series styles.
- Measure/layout/draw stages, backend clipping, arbitrary text angles and calendar/timezone tick policies.
- Figures/subplots with aligned areas, shared axes/legends and captions.
- Text/arrow annotations; series IDs and replace/remove/update APIs.
- DPI/physical dimensions, PDF paper/orientation and transparency contracts.

Native scatter/bubble and strict vector fallback are already locally implemented; retain their regressions. Create focused child issues and a small axis/figure design proposal when this tracker becomes active. No release version or delivery date is promised.

later.title: [M3] Statistical and business chart breadth — deferred
later.body:
Outcome: documented statistical/reporting semantics with matching raster/vector output.

Delivery order:
1. Asymmetric x/y error bars and lower/upper uncertainty ribbons.
2. Heatmaps with normalization, sequential/diverging color scales, missing cells and colorbars.
3. Box plots with explicit quartiles, whiskers and outliers.
4. Histogram custom edges, weights, density/probability and cumulative variants.
5. Waterfall, floating/range bars and Pareto.
6. Demand-led polar/radar, Gantt, gauges and treemap; contours after continuous-axis and heatmap foundations.

Depends on M2 axis/layout/clipping foundations. Each family needs an API guide, example, gallery, numeric/render regressions, missing-value semantics, resource limits and install integration. Split into child issues when promoted; no delivery dates.

later.title: [M4] Accessible output and ecosystem integrations — deferred
later.body:
Outcome: accessible, international and embeddable reporting with documented lifecycle/error behavior.

Planned scope:
- SVG title/description metadata and CSV/data-table companion exports.
- Patterns/markers and grayscale/colorblind reporting guidance.
- Optional shaping, RTL and fallback fonts.
- C ABI and optional Python wrapper; WASM builds/examples.
- Pixel-aware decimation preserving gaps/spikes/original x positions.
- Large-data and embedded memory/throughput benchmarks.
- Additional distributions based on adopter demand.

Plan after M1 and prioritize against demonstrated users; do not infer fixed release dates. Conan and the existing vcpkg port remain M1 packaging work, not silently deferred here.

later.title: [Later] Finance, interaction and specialized output — demand-led backlog
later.body:
Deferred workstreams, with no release commitments:

- Finance: OHLC/candlestick and volume panels with shared time axes; validated SMA/EMA/RSI/MACD/Bollinger/ATR/stochastic; independent panels, trends and annotations.
- Interaction: original series/point hit-test identity, consumer-driven zoom/pan and incremental updates; browser wrapper only after identity/interaction contracts exist.
- Specialized output: EPS/PostScript and C++ source-array export with a concrete use case; evaluate 3D separately.

Finance depends on M2 time axes and subplot composition. Interaction depends on series identity and lifecycle. Activate individual proposals only with a maintainer-reviewed workflow and acceptance criteria.
